text:
sara: quick note — we're seeing a drift between heartbeat pings and billing events for resumed streams; looks like heartbeats don't carry the attribution tag when a toolcall is active :thinking_face:

mike: can you paste an example log line? are these heartbeats coming from the sidecar or router?

sara: router. sample: `INFO resume_heartbeat session=abc123 offset=1024 tags=[] toolcall=true` — notice tags empty even though earlier toolcall events had `tags=[tool:search]`

eva: that explains it — the billing pipeline relies on tags to decide which ledger to increment. empty tags => provisional route gets used, so customers see ghost charges on fallback routes.

ton y: (typo) tony: +1. Is this only for resumed streams or all heartbeats on streaming retries?

sara: primarily resume/reconnect paths where we inject a lightweight heartbeat to keep session alive while router hands off. regular continuous heartbeats include tags. resume path uses a thrift call that was never updated to carry `metadata.tags`

mike: oh nice catch. So options: 1) include tags on resume heartbeat (small change in router thrift), 2) have billing infer attribution from last confirmed toolcall in ledger (heuristic), 3) mark resume heartbeats as non-billable and rely on final tokenization event.

eva: option 3 is risky — some customers want immediate provisional billing for reserved pools. option 2 adds complexity and could misattribute when session hops between regions.

ton y: prefer 1. simple, deterministic. but need rollout plan — router change touches hot path.

sara: proposal: add `metadata.tags` to ResumeHeartbeat message, default to empty. ship behind `router.resume_tags` feature flag. Canary on dedicated region eu-west-2 first.

mike: +1. also add a console metric: `heartbeat_tag_absent{route,model}` and an alert when rate > 0.5% of resume heartbeats. Helps detect clients still not tagging.

eva: update billing pipeline to ignore resume heartbeats without tags until flag is off — fallback safe mode. That avoids immediate misbilling during rollout.

@sara: I'll open a PR for the thrift change and a short changelog. @mike can you add the metric? @tony can you coordinate canary with infra? I'll file a ticket: #PLAT-4682 and link to deploy steps.

billing-bot: notice: billing ingestion lag normal. No invoices affected yet.

sara: thanks — assigning owners: sara (spec + PR), mike (metrics + alert), tony (canary ops), eva (billing fallback config). Plan to ship in 48–72h if no blockers. :rocket:
